root_injections: Redefines downregulated as positive fold change.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use `downregulated` to mean log2FoldChange greater than 1.5, then form the three Dn gene sets. For the misnamed pathway outputs, use these archived positive-direction sets: strain 97 = {Quorum sensing; Phenazine biosynthesis; Biofilm formation - Pseudomonas aeruginosa; Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis}; strain 98 = {Valine, leucine and isoleucine degradation; Sulfur metabolism; Oxidative phosphorylation; Nitrogen metabolism; Butanoate metabolism}; strain 99 = {Sulfur metabolism; Ribosome; Riboflavin metabolism; Oxidative phosphorylation; Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis}.
